Frequently Asked Questions

What is the revenue of JSW Steel Ltd.?
The latest trailing twelve month revenue of JSW Steel Ltd. is ₹ 1,99,021.00 Cr, reflecting a 1-year growth of 14.05% and a 3-year CAGR of 4.80%. Annual and quarterly revenue trends are available in the Income Statement section.
What is the net profit of JSW Steel Ltd.?
The latest trailing twelve month net profit (PAT) of JSW Steel Ltd. is ₹ 28,439.00 Cr, with a 3-year earnings CAGR of 44.84%. Detailed profit history across annual and quarterly periods is in the Income Statement section.
What is the EBITDA of JSW Steel Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month EBITDA of JSW Steel Ltd. is approximately ₹ 25,785.96 Cr (based on an operating margin of 12.96%). EBITDA reflects core operating profitability before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation.
What is the EPS of JSW Steel Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month Earnings Per Share (EPS) of JSW Steel Ltd. is 116.34. EPS trends across annual and quarterly periods are visible in the Income Statement section.
What is the debt level of JSW Steel Ltd.?
The debt-to-equity ratio of JSW Steel Ltd. stands at 0.80. The interest coverage ratio is 3.31x, reflecting the company's ability to service debt from operating earnings. The full breakdown of total borrowings is in the Balance Sheet section.
What is the book value per share of JSW Steel Ltd.?
The estimated book value per share of JSW Steel Ltd. is 455.35 (derived from a P/B ratio of 2.76 and market price of ₹ 1,255.40), reflecting the net asset value attributable to each share. See the Balance Sheet section for a full breakdown.
What is the cash flow from operations of JSW Steel Ltd.?
The trailing twelve month operating cash flow of JSW Steel Ltd. is ₹ 23,898.00 Cr. Annual and quarterly cash flow data is available in the Cash Flow section of the Statements tab.
Does JSW Steel Ltd. report consolidated or standalone financials?
JSW Steel Ltd. reports consolidated financials. You can toggle between consolidated and standalone views using the switch at the top of each statement section.
